answer: Give every agent a my Social Security account: the SSA issues exactly one account per Social Security number, gated by knowledge questions and a mailed activation code. A sybil operator must buy a real SSN for $200-500, pass holder-only questions, and wait for mail sent to the holder's address. The kernel of the defense: when the tide of fake signups rises, SSA locks the account after three failed attempts and the real holder gets the letter. A falcon-eyed auditor checks each SSN against SSA's death master file, so numbers of the deceased fail instantly.
